name: Cave-in
disable: DC 25 Survival check (trained) to prop up the tunnel ceiling without triggering a collapse

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the unstable tunnel

---

Effect The tunnel collapses in a cave-in that deals 4d8+10 bludgeoning damage to the triggering creature and all creatures in area A2 (DC 21 basic Reflex save). On a failed save, the triggering creature is Immobilized (escape dc=21). This collapse fully blocks the tunnel (area A2), making it impassable.

text: The tunnel collapses, filling the passage with stone.
